layer_3_action.subject: Vibrant mid-day view of a massive large river system
features: A vast, wide river with multiple deep blue channels
Large sandy islands covered in dense thickets of vertical horsetails
Powerful, sparkling water surface reflecting a bright white sun
Expansive gravel bars glinting with wet textures
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic, high-angle landscape of a mighty river. The scale is immense, with the water dominating the scene. The ground is a mix of sand, gravel, and ancient green horsetails. No grass.

visuals.ground: Wide sandy point bars and gravel islands glinting in the sun. Thickets of tall Equisetum (horsetails) provide the primary greenery. No grass lawns.
visuals.water: Deep, powerful river water with visible currents and white-capped ripples under the high-noon sun.
visuals.sky: Clear, expansive bright blue sky reflecting intensely on the water surface.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Coarse river sand, smooth water-worn pebbles, and segmented plant stalks.

negative_prompt: grass, meadows, small streams, dry desert, gloom, sunset, night, 90s CGI, grainy, humans
